senses.en: in fact, or very

ex.en: I really want to understand this poem.
ex.zh: 我真的想读懂这首诗。

ex.en: A programme is not really successful if only the students who already read a lot take part.
ex.zh: 如果只有本来就读得很多的学生参加，一个项目并不能算真正成功。

tip: really 修饰形容词或动词，强调程度或真实性。

senses.en: to cook food in an oven or over a fire
cooked in that way

ex.en: We roast potatoes with the chicken.
ex.zh: 我们把土豆和鸡一起烤。

ex.en: Roast chicken smells wonderful, but you still have to check that the centre is hot.
ex.zh: 烤鸡很香，但你仍要确认里面是热的。

tip: roast 多指烤箱或明火烤大块食物。薄片快煎更常用 fry。

senses.en: used for polite requests, habits, or imagined results

ex.en: Would you help me carry these books?
ex.zh: 你愿意帮我搬这些书吗？

ex.en: Many students would revise more calmly if tests were spread across the term instead of piled into one week.
ex.zh: 如果考试分散在整个学期，而不是堆在一周里，许多学生会复习得更从容。

tip: would like to do 是礼貌的“想要”；would rather do 表示宁愿。

senses.en: in addition

ex.en: She plays the piano and also sings in the choir.
ex.zh: 她弹钢琴，还在合唱团唱歌。

ex.en: Parks also reduce noise, which matters for schools built beside busy roads.
ex.zh: 公园还能降低噪音，这对建在繁忙道路旁的学校很重要。

tip: also 多放在句中；too 和 as well 多放在句末。

senses.en: a taxi

ex.en: A cab waited outside the station in the rain.
ex.zh: 雨中，一辆出租车等在车站外面。

ex.en: The cab driver knew a shorter road, so we reached the hall before the speech began.
ex.zh: 出租车司机认得一条近路，我们在演讲开始前到了礼堂。

tip: cab 就是 taxi，口语里很常见。车费是 fare，不是 fee 专指这一项时也常说 fare。

senses.en: the way a word is spoken

ex.en: That vowel pronunciation still varies.
ex.zh: 那个元音的读音仍然不统一。

ex.en: Check the pronunciation in a dictionary when the spelling does not show which syllable is strong.
ex.zh: 拼写看不出哪个音节重读时，就到词典里核对发音。

tip: pronunciation 是名词，重音在 -nun- 前的音节附近，和动词 pronounce 不同。本批两条都有，不要合成一个词。

senses.en: a thin flat piece cut from something
to cut into slices

ex.en: He ate one slice of bread and left the rest.
ex.zh: 他吃了一片面包，剩下的没动。

ex.en: Slice the lemon thinly so each cup of tea gets a piece.
ex.zh: 把柠檬切薄，这样每杯茶都能分到一片。

col: a slice of bread｜一片面包
tip: 参考表音标是 sleeve（袖子）的，本卡不用。sleeve 还在考纲里。a slice of bread 是真能吃到的一片，不是空搭配。

senses.en: a very large animal with a trunk

ex.en: The elephant in the zoo sprayed water with its trunk.
ex.zh: 动物园里的象用鼻子喷水。

ex.en: An elephant needs more space than our city zoo can give, the guide said.
ex.zh: 导游说，一头象需要的空间比我们城市动物园能给的更大。

tip: 象鼻是 trunk，耳朵是 ears。不定冠词用 an。

senses.en: in what way, or to what degree

ex.en: How do you spell your family name?
ex.zh: 你的姓怎么拼？

ex.en: How a city treats its rivers often shows how seriously it takes public health.
ex.zh: 一座城市如何对待河流，常常说明它有多重视公共健康。

tip: How 加形容词或副词构成感叹句；What 加名词。

senses.en: minced meat packed in a tube

ex.en: Grill one sausage for each person.
ex.zh: 每人烤一根香肠。

ex.en: The sausage in the bun was too salty, so she added cucumber from the side plate.
ex.zh: 面包里的香肠太咸，她就加了配菜碟里的黄瓜。

tip: 一根香肠是 a sausage。英式早餐里常有 sausages，用复数。

senses.en: to plan and arrange something

ex.en: We organize the book sale every May.
ex.zh: 我们每年五月组织售书。

ex.en: The class will organize a museum visit if enough students sign the list this week.
ex.zh: 要是这周有足够的学生签名，全班会组织一次博物馆参观。

tip: 美式拼作 organize。英式常作 organise，意思相同。
note: 美式拼写。英式 organise 不在这一窗口里。

senses.en: full of energy

ex.en: The energetic puppy woke the house.
ex.zh: 精力旺盛的小狗把全家吵醒了。

ex.en: An energetic warm-up is useful, but stop if your knee hurts.
ex.zh: 热身做得起劲有好处，可是膝盖疼就要停。

col: an energetic child｜精力充沛的孩子
tip: energetic 形容人或活动。名词是 energy，不是 energeticness。

senses.en: space between two points
A lack of emotional closeness between people
To separate yourself from someone, something, or their views

ex.en: Keep a safe distance from the fire.
ex.zh: 与火保持安全距离。

ex.en: Reducing the distance between residential areas and workplaces could lower transport emissions and improve urban quality of life.
ex.zh: 缩短住宅区与工作地点之间的距离，可以减少交通排放并改善城市生活质量。

tip: in the distance指在远处；at a distance指隔一段距离。

senses.en: for what reason

ex.en: Why is the lab closed this afternoon?
ex.zh: 实验室今天下午为什么关门？

ex.en: Understanding why a species disappears is the first step toward protecting the habitat it needs.
ex.zh: 弄清一个物种为何消失，是保护它所需栖息地的第一步。

col: that is why｜那就是为什么
tip: Why not do...? 用来提出建议，后面接动词原形。

senses.en: a son of one's son or daughter

ex.en: Her grandson visits every Spring Festival.
ex.zh: 她的孙子每年春节都来。

ex.en: The old sailor showed his grandson how to fold the flag before they left the harbour wall.
ex.zh: 老水手教孙子在离开防波堤之前把旗子叠好。

col: a grandson of hers｜她的一个孙子
tip: 孙子、外孙都是 grandson。孙女、外孙女是 granddaughter。

senses.en: a tool for making holes, or repeated practice
to make a hole or to train by repetition

ex.en: The fire drill emptied the building in four minutes.
ex.zh: 消防演习四分钟内把楼清空了。

ex.en: He drilled a small hole for the hook, then we practiced the same step ten times.
ex.zh: 他为挂钩钻了一个小孔，然后我们把同一步骤练了十遍。

tip: drill 既可以是操练，也可以是钻头。消防演习是 fire drill。

senses.en: to put a body or an object under the ground

ex.en: They bury the seeds two centimetres deep.
ex.zh: 他们把种子埋两厘米深。

ex.en: Snow may bury the path overnight, so the caretaker clears it before the first class.
ex.zh: 雪一夜之间可能盖住小路，所以管理员在第一节课前把它清开。

tip: bury 的过去式是 buried。不要和 berry（浆果）看混。

senses.en: a piece of paper showing that you paid

ex.en: Keep the receipt in case you return it.
ex.zh: 把收据留着，以便退货。

ex.en: The receipt shows the date and the price, which the office needs for the club account.
ex.zh: 收据上有日期和价格，社团报账时办公室要看。

col: ask for a receipt｜索要收据
tip: receipt 里的 p 不发音，重音在第二音节。收到是 receive。

senses.en: one of the large land masses of the earth

ex.en: We colored one continent on the blank map.
ex.zh: 我们在空白地图上给一个大洲上了色。

ex.en: Africa is a continent, and the quiz asks which ocean lies on its eastern side.
ex.zh: 非洲是一个大洲，测验问它东边是哪片海。

tip: continent 是大洲。country 是国家，island 是岛。

senses.en: also, or more than enough

ex.en: This box is too heavy for one person.
ex.zh: 这个箱子一个人搬太重了。

ex.en: If tickets are too expensive, a museum built with public money will not serve the public.
ex.zh: 如果门票太贵，用公共资金建造的博物馆就服务不了公众。

tip: too...to do 表示太……而不能；also 不能放在这个结构里。

senses.en: behaving in a way that shows respect

ex.en: A polite request works better than a shout.
ex.zh: 有礼貌的请求比喊叫有用。

ex.en: It is polite to wait until the speaker finishes, even if you disagree with the point.
ex.zh: 即使不同意，等发言的人说完也是礼貌。

col: polite to sb｜对某人有礼貌
tip: It is polite to do sth。反义 rude。副词 politely。

senses.en: the basic unit of length, 100 centimetres

ex.en: The desk is about one meter wide.
ex.zh: 这张桌子大约一米宽。

ex.en: They measured the hall again and found it was two meters shorter than the plan.
ex.zh: 他们又量了一遍礼堂，发现比图纸短两米。

tip: 考纲另有 metre。参考表把 meter 标成 metre 的美式拼写，意思是长度单位。仪表是另一个常见义，本卡按表先记「米」。

senses.en: a male member of the police

ex.en: A policeman directed traffic at the gate.
ex.zh: 一名警察在大门口指挥交通。

ex.en: The policeman asked us to stand on the pavement until the ambulance had passed.
ex.zh: 警察让我们站在人行道上，直到救护车过去。

col: a policeman on duty｜值班警察
tip: policeman 传统上指男警察。女警察是 policewoman。中性说法是 police officer。police 是集体名词。

senses.en: power to work; power source
Power used to produce heat, movement, light, or electricity

ex.en: Young people have lots of energy.
ex.zh: 年轻人有很多精力。

ex.en: Investing in renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels while creating new employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，同时创造新的就业机会。

tip: 表示精力或能源时通常不可数，不说 an energy。

senses.en: to arrange people or things so they work well

ex.en: Who will organise the book sale?
ex.zh: 谁来组织这次售书？

ex.en: They organise the files by date, which makes last March easy to find during the review.
ex.zh: 他们按日期整理文件，复习时去年三月就很容易找到。

tip: organise 是英式动词。美式 organize 已在库里。名词 organisation，美式 organization。

senses.en: a soft covering for the foot, worn inside a shoe

ex.en: One sock is still on the line.
ex.zh: 还有一只短袜在绳子上。

ex.en: Bring a spare sock if the field is muddy, because a wet foot makes the afternoon hike miserable.
ex.zh: 场地要是泥泞，就多带一只短袜，脚湿了下午的徒步会很难受。

col: a pair of socks｜一双短袜
tip: 通常说 a pair of socks。一只是 a sock。长筒袜是 stocking，本批后面另有一条。

senses.en: a person who is on a journey; the American spelling

ex.en: A tired traveler asked for water.
ex.zh: 一个疲倦的旅行者要了水。

ex.en: One traveler missed the morning train and used the delay to rewrite field notes in the station cafe.
ex.zh: 有一位旅行者误了早班火车，便利用等候时间在车站咖啡馆里改野外笔记。

col: a lone traveler｜独自的旅行者
tip: traveler 是美式拼写。英式 traveller 在本批另有一条，例句和意思都分开写。

senses.en: on or to a higher floor
on a higher floor

ex.en: The lab is upstairs, next to the art room.
ex.zh: 实验室在楼上，美术室旁边。

ex.en: An upstairs window was open all night, so the books on that desk felt damp.
ex.zh: 楼上的一扇窗开了一夜，那张桌上的书摸着有些潮。

tip: upstairs 可作副词或形容词。上楼是 go upstairs，不要说 go to upstairs。

senses.en: the joint between the foot and the leg

ex.en: She twisted her ankle on the wet stair.
ex.zh: 她在湿台阶上扭了脚踝。

ex.en: The nurse wrapped his ankle and told him to skip football for a week.
ex.zh: 护士包好他的脚踝，让他一周别踢足球。

tip: 脚踝是 ankle。手腕是 wrist。不要对调。

senses.en: a small animal with six legs and usually wings

ex.en: An insect with six legs landed on the leaf.
ex.zh: 一只六条腿的昆虫落在叶子上。

ex.en: Not every small creature is an insect: a spider has eight legs, and the chart shows that.
ex.zh: 不是每种小动物都是昆虫：蜘蛛有八条腿，图上标着呢。

tip: 昆虫六条腿。蜘蛛不是 insect。口语 bug 更宽，不完全等同。

senses.en: a contest
An organised event in which people try to win.

ex.en: She won first prize in the competition.
ex.zh: 她在比赛中获得一等奖。

ex.en: Competition between businesses can lower prices, but effective regulation is needed to protect consumers from unfair practices.
ex.zh: 企业间的竞争可以降低价格，但仍需有效监管来保护消费者免受不公平商业行为的侵害。

tip: 表示竞争通常不可数；表示一场比赛时可数。

senses.en: something that makes success more difficult

ex.en: Height is not a disadvantage in this role.
ex.zh: 这个角色里身高不是劣势。

ex.en: The disadvantage of a late start is real, and a clear plan can still reduce it.
ex.zh: 起步晚的不利是真的，一份清楚的计划仍然能把它缩小。

col: at a disadvantage｜处于不利地位
tip: at a disadvantage 处于不利地位。讨论题常把 advantages and disadvantages 放在一起。

senses.en: to talk about
to examine a subject in speech or writing

ex.en: Let's discuss the plan after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后我们讨论一下计划。

ex.en: Students should discuss different solutions before deciding how to reduce waste on their campus.
ex.zh: 学生应先讨论不同的解决办法，再决定如何减少校园垃圾。

col: discuss something with someone｜与某人讨论某事
tip: 直接接讨论内容：discuss sth，不加about。

senses.en: a long piece of music for an orchestra

ex.en: The symphony has four movements.
ex.zh: 这部交响乐有四个乐章。

ex.en: We heard the symphony on the radio and followed the slow movement with the score.
ex.zh: 我们从收音机里听这部交响乐，并照着总谱听慢乐章。

tip: 一部交响曲是 a symphony。乐团是 a symphony orchestra。形容词 symphonic。

senses.en: to tell someone what you think they should do

ex.en: I advise you to sleep before the listening test.
ex.zh: 我建议你听力考试前先睡觉。

ex.en: The coach advised the runners not to start fast just because the crowd was loud.
ex.zh: 教练劝跑步的人不要因为观众吵就起跑太快。

col: advise sb to do｜建议某人做
tip: 动词 advise，名词 advice 不可数，已在词库。advise doing 和 advise sb to do 都可以。

senses.en: to create something that did not exist before

ex.en: She did not invent the machine alone.
ex.zh: 这台机器不是她一个人发明的。

ex.en: People invent tools to solve a problem, whereas they discover a star that was already there.
ex.zh: 人们发明工具是为了解决问题，而发现一颗星星时，那颗星本来就在。

col: invent a device｜发明一种装置
tip: invent 是发明原来没有的东西。discover 已在库里，是发现已存在的东西。invention 也已在库里。invent an excuse 是编借口。

senses.en: to measure how heavy something is

ex.en: Weigh the salt on the digital scale.
ex.zh: 用电子秤称一下盐。

ex.en: Weigh yourself before the race and write the number next to your name.
ex.zh: 赛前称一下体重，把数字写在你的名字旁边。

tip: 动词 weigh。名词重量是 weight，已在词库。

senses.en: to find for the first time

ex.en: Scientists discover new planets every year.
ex.zh: 科学家每年都发现新行星。

ex.en: Scientists may discover new ways to treat diseases by studying plants in tropical forests.
ex.zh: 科学家可能通过研究热带森林中的植物，发现治疗疾病的新方法。

col: discover a new species｜发现新物种
tip: discover发现原本存在的事物；invent创造新事物。

senses.en: to move or travel to a place

ex.en: We go to the stadium on Friday afternoons.
ex.zh: 我们周五下午去体育馆。

ex.en: If food prices go up too quickly, families may buy less fresh fruit for their children.
ex.zh: 如果食品价格涨得太快，家庭可能会给孩子少买新鲜水果。

tip: go 的过去式是 went，过去分词是 gone。

senses.en: the light that comes from the sun

ex.en: Sunlight filled the art room by ten.
ex.zh: 十点时阳光铺满了美术教室。

ex.en: Keep the seedlings in sunlight, but move them under the desk if the glass gets too hot.
ex.zh: 让幼苗照到阳光，玻璃太烫时就把它们挪到桌下。

tip: sunlight 多作不可数名词。晒太阳是 in the sunlight，不要说 under the sunlight。

senses.en: towards the front

ex.en: Take one step forwards, then stop.
ex.zh: 向前走一步，然后停下。

ex.en: The queue moved forwards only when the door opened, so nobody pushed from the back.
ex.zh: 门开了队伍才向前移，所以没有人从后面推。

tip: 英式副词常用 forwards。没有 s 的 forward 已在库里，意思相近。向后是 backwards。
note: 英式副词 forwards。forward 已另列，不合并。

senses.en: a person who catches fish for a job or as a sport

ex.en: The fisherman mended a net.
ex.zh: 渔民补了一张网。

ex.en: A fisherman on the lake sets out before dawn, and the geography photo shows the lamps on the boats.
ex.zh: 湖上的渔民黎明前就出发，地理照片拍下了船上的灯。

tip: 复数是 fishermen，不是 fishermans。fish 已在库里。性别不明时有人用 fisher。

senses.en: the words a person or a language uses

ex.en: Keep a vocabulary notebook by subject.
ex.zh: 按话题记一本词汇笔记本。

ex.en: A wide vocabulary helps you read the article, but you still need grammar to build the sentence.
ex.zh: 词汇量大有助于读这篇文章，造句仍然需要语法。

tip: vocabulary 集合名词，一般不加复数。扩大词汇是 build / enlarge your vocabulary。

senses.en: a thin tube of tobacco that people smoke

ex.en: The gate sign says cigarettes are not allowed on campus.
ex.zh: 门口的牌子写着校园内不许吸烟。

ex.en: He dropped a cigarette by the gym, and the guard made him pick it up.
ex.zh: 他把一支烟扔在体育馆旁边，保安让他捡起来。

tip: cigarette 是纸烟。校园规定里常直接禁止。

senses.en: using electricity
Full of excitement and energy.

ex.en: electric cars produce less smoke.
ex.zh: 电动汽车产生更少烟雾。

ex.en: Electric buses can reduce urban air pollution, especially when their power comes from renewable sources.
ex.zh: 电动公交车可以减少城市空气污染，尤其是在使用可再生能源供电时。

tip: 电动设备多用electric；电气系统多用electrical。

senses.en: easy to use or reach
Situated close to somewhere you need to reach.

ex.en: Online payment is convenient.
ex.zh: 在线支付很方便。

ex.en: Online learning offers a convenient way for working adults to develop skills without travelling to a campus.
ex.zh: 在线学习为在职成年人提供了无需前往校园就能提升技能的便捷途径。

col: a convenient way to｜做……的便捷方式
tip: 说 It is convenient for me，不说 I am convenient。

senses.en: a box, bottle, or jar used to hold something

ex.en: Write the date on the container before you store the powder.
ex.zh: 存放粉末前先在容器上写日期。

ex.en: The container cracked in the freezer, and the soup leaked onto the other food.
ex.zh: 容器在冰箱里裂了，汤漏到了别的食物上。

tip: container 是装东西的器皿，也可以指货运集装箱。

senses.en: a feeling that something is unfortunate, or sympathy
to feel sorry for someone

ex.en: It is a pity that the match was cancelled.
ex.zh: 比赛取消了，真可惜。

ex.en: She felt pity for the wet dog and brought a dry towel from the gym office.
ex.zh: 她可怜那只湿淋淋的狗，从体育馆办公室拿来一条干毛巾。

tip: It's a pity that... 表遗憾。同情某人是 feel pity for sb。

senses.en: the time or the crop when farmers gather food
to gather a crop

ex.en: Students helped with the grape harvest on Saturday.
ex.zh: 星期六学生们去帮忙收葡萄。

ex.en: They harvest the rice in October, when most of our exams are already over.
ex.zh: 他们十月收稻，那时我们大部分考试已经结束。

tip: harvest 可作名词或动词。参考表是收割、收获物。

senses.en: a strong-smelling plant used in cooking

ex.en: Add one clove of garlic to the soup.
ex.zh: 往汤里加一瓣蒜。

ex.en: She fried the garlic first, because the rest of the dish would taste flat without it.
ex.zh: 她先把蒜炒香，不然这道菜其余的味道会发闷。

tip: 一瓣蒜是 a clove of garlic。garlic 作材料时多不可数。

senses.en: the last meal of the day, or a light evening meal

ex.en: Supper is noodles and fruit tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚晚饭是面条和水果。

ex.en: We ate supper late because the rehearsal did not end until the hall lights dimmed.
ex.zh: 彩排直到礼堂灯光暗下来才结束，我们晚饭吃得很晚。

tip: supper 多指晚上较随便的一餐。正式的晚饭也可以说 dinner，各地习惯不同。

senses.en: busy doing things
currently working or producing an effect
describing a verb whose subject performs the action

ex.en: Stay active after school.
ex.zh: 放学后保持活跃。

ex.en: Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励积极运动的生活方式，以改善学生的身体健康和整体身心状态。

col: an active lifestyle｜积极运动的生活方式
play an active role｜发挥积极作用
tip: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

senses.en: bread made hot and brown
to brown bread, or to drink in someone's honour

ex.en: She spread honey on a piece of toast.
ex.zh: 她在一片烤面包上抹了蜂蜜。

ex.en: At the end of dinner they toast the retiring coach and thank him for ten quiet years.
ex.zh: 晚饭末了，他们向即将退休的教练敬酒，感谢他安安静静的十年。

col: a slice of toast｜一片烤面包
tip: 一片烤面包常用 a piece of toast，toast 作食物时多不可数。干杯也是 toast。

senses.en: at what time, or at the time that

ex.en: When does the library close tonight?
ex.zh: 图书馆今晚什么时候关门？

ex.en: When young people only meet friends online, they may lose practice in reading faces and tones.
ex.zh: 当年轻人只在网上见朋友时，他们可能缺少辨认表情和语气的练习。

tip: when 引导时间状语从句时，从句常用一般现在时表将来。

senses.en: a person trained to travel in a spacecraft

ex.en: The astronaut waved from the screen.
ex.zh: 宇航员在屏幕里挥了挥手。

ex.en: An astronaut trains for months before a flight, and the science page lists sleep, food, and exercise in orbit.
ex.zh: 宇航员飞行前要训练好几个月，科学专页列出了轨道上的睡眠、饮食和锻炼。

col: train as an astronaut｜接受宇航员训练
tip: astronaut 是航天员。俄国传统说法 cosmonaut 不必写进这条。太空舱见 capsule。

senses.en: a person who paints pictures, or who paints walls

ex.en: The painter left brushes in a jar of water.
ex.zh: 画家把画笔留在一罐水里。

ex.en: A house painter covered the floor before he started on the classroom walls.
ex.zh: 油漆工先把地板罩上，再刷教室的墙。

tip: painter 既是画家，也是刷墙的油漆工。看句子里的 brushes 或 walls。

senses.en: to walk without a fixed plan, or for the mind to drift

ex.en: We wander through the old market.
ex.zh: 我们在旧市场里随便走走。

ex.en: Minds wander when a lecture runs long, so the speaker paused and asked a short question.
ex.zh: 讲座一长，心思就会飘走，于是讲的人停下来问了一个很短的问题。

tip: wander 既是没有目的地走，也是走神。不要和 wonder（想知道）弄混。

senses.en: a small rubber bag filled with air or gas

ex.en: A red balloon escaped over the wall.
ex.zh: 一只红气球飞过了墙。

ex.en: The science balloon carried a small box that recorded the temperature high above the field.
ex.zh: 科学气球带了一只小盒子，记录田野高空的温度。

tip: 气球是 balloon。球是 ball。热气球是 hot-air balloon。

senses.en: to need support; to be decided by
to need or trust someone or something for support

ex.en: Success may depend on hard work.
ex.zh: 成功可能取决于努力。

ex.en: Many rural communities depend on reliable public transport to access healthcare, education, and employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 许多农村社区依靠可靠的公共交通来获得医疗、教育和就业机会。

col: depend on someone to do something｜指望某人做某事
tip: 常接on或upon；It depends意为“看情况”。

senses.en: to disagree with something and try to stop it

ex.en: Many parents oppose the late practice.
ex.zh: 许多家长反对这么晚的训练。

ex.en: I oppose the plan only because the cost is higher than the club can pay.
ex.zh: 我反对这个计划，只是因为费用高于社团付得起的数目。

col: oppose a plan｜反对一项计划
tip: oppose 后面直接加宾语，不说 oppose to。be opposed to 才要 to。

senses.en: a box that slides out of a desk or cupboard

ex.en: Look in the top drawer for the spare key.
ex.zh: 备用钥匙在最上面的抽屉里找。

ex.en: She emptied the drawer onto the desk and found the stamp under a stack of forms.
ex.zh: 她把抽屉倒在桌上，在一叠表格底下找到了邮票。

tip: drawer 是抽屉，来自 draw「拉出」。重音在第一个音节。不要把它理解成画画的人。

senses.en: the device that slows or stops a vehicle
to slow or stop with the brake

ex.en: The back brake on this bike is loose.
ex.zh: 这辆车的后刹车松了。

ex.en: She had to brake hard when a dog ran across the empty street at dusk.
ex.zh: 黄昏时一条狗冲过空街，她只好猛地刹车。

tip: 刹车是 brake。打断是 break。两词同音，拼写不同。

senses.en: the natural view of a place, or the painted scene on a stage

ex.en: The lake scenery stopped the bus.
ex.zh: 湖景让车子停了下来。

ex.en: Mountain scenery fills the first chapter, while the play later uses painted scenery for the same valley.
ex.zh: 第一章写满了山景，后面的戏剧又用绘出的布景表现同一条山谷。

tip: scenery 不可数，不说 a scenery 或 sceneries。舞台布景也用这个词。scene 可以数。

senses.en: a machine that keeps food cold

ex.en: Put the milk back in the fridge.
ex.zh: 把牛奶放回冰箱。

ex.en: The samples stay in the fridge overnight, on the top shelf, away from the fruit.
ex.zh: 样本在冰箱里放一夜，放在顶层，离水果远一点。

tip: fridge 是 refrigerator 的口语说法，考纲里两个词都有。参考表这一行的音标是 refrigerator 的，本卡不用。

senses.en: powder made from grain, used for bread

ex.en: Dust the board with flour before you roll the dough.
ex.zh: 擀面团之前先在板上撒一点面粉。

ex.en: The flour was damp, so the bread did not rise and we started another bowl.
ex.zh: 面粉受潮了，面包没发起来，我们又重新和了一盆。

col: a bag of flour｜一袋面粉
tip: flour 是面粉。flower 是花，已在词库。读音接近，拼写不同。

senses.en: to notice with the eyes, or to understand

ex.en: I can see the playground from this window.
ex.zh: 我从这扇窗户能看见操场。

ex.en: When people see the cost of wasted food, they are more willing to change what they buy.
ex.zh: 当人们看到浪费食物的代价时，他们更愿意改变购买习惯。

tip: see 强调看见的结果；look 强调看的动作；watch 强调持续观看。

senses.en: a man who works in business, especially as an owner

ex.en: A local businessman paid for the new books.
ex.zh: 一位本地商人付了新书的钱。

ex.en: The businessman visited the workshop and asked how many desks the students still needed.
ex.zh: 那位商人参观了工坊，问学生还缺多少张桌子。

tip: 考纲这一条是 businessman。女性商人常说 businesswoman。复数 businessmen 别写错。

senses.en: a sweet fruit that is narrow at the top and wider at the bottom

ex.en: This pear is still hard.
ex.zh: 这个梨还是硬的。

ex.en: She sliced a pear into the salad, then saved the second one for the ride home.
ex.zh: 她把一个梨切片加进沙拉，把第二个留到回家的路上吃。

tip: pear 和 pair（一对）同音。写的时候看上下文。复数 pears。

senses.en: a tool with points for lifting food

ex.en: There is a fork beside the plate, and a spoon on the right.
ex.zh: 盘子旁边有一把叉，右边有一把勺。

ex.en: He dropped his fork under the table and had to borrow one from the next tray.
ex.zh: 他把叉子掉到桌下，只好从旁边的托盘借了一把。

col: a knife and fork｜一副刀叉
tip: 参考表是餐叉。路的分岔也可以叫 a fork in the road，本卡先记餐具。

senses.en: a person whose job is cutting men's hair

ex.en: The barber opens at nine on Saturday.
ex.zh: 理发师星期六九点开门。

ex.en: A barber in the old street still uses scissors more often than electric clippers.
ex.zh: 老街上的理发师用剪刀仍比电推子多。

tip: barber 传统上给男士理发。hairdresser 男女都可以。理发店是 a barber's。

senses.en: later than a time or event
at a later time than

ex.en: We clean the lab after each experiment.
ex.zh: 每次实验后我们都打扫实验室。

ex.en: After a major flood, schools may have to share buildings until their own classrooms are safe again.
ex.zh: 大洪水之后，学校可能不得不共用校舍，直到自己的教室再次安全。

tip: after 是介词或连词；副词“后来”常用 afterwards 或 later。

senses.en: to grow or improve
to create a new product, method, or idea
to begin to have a condition, problem, or feeling

ex.en: Reading helps develop your vocabulary.
ex.zh: 阅读有助于培养词汇量。

ex.en: Governments should fund research to develop affordable technologies that address water shortages in rural communities.
ex.zh: 政府应资助研究，开发价格可负担的技术，以解决农村社区的缺水问题。

tip: 可及物也可不及物：develop skills；skills develop。

senses.en: a book in which you write what happens each day

ex.en: She writes in her diary after lights-out.
ex.zh: 熄灯后她写日记。

ex.en: He left his diary on the lab bench, and three pages of private notes were open.
ex.zh: 他把日记落在实验台上，三页私人笔记摊开着。

tip: diary 是日记。dairy 是乳品，只差一个字母。

senses.en: with a lot of wind

ex.en: It is too windy for the kite.
ex.zh: 风太大，风筝放不了。

ex.en: A windy platform makes loose papers fly, so the group clips every sheet before the train arrives.
ex.zh: 有风的站台会把散页吹走，所以小组在火车进站前把每张纸都夹住。

tip: windy 形容天气。wind 已在库里，作名词是风，作动词是缠绕或蜿蜒，读音不同。比较级 windier。

senses.en: in or to what place

ex.en: Where did you leave your sports shoes?
ex.zh: 你把运动鞋放在哪儿了？

ex.en: Cities need places where teenagers can meet without having to spend money.
ex.zh: 城市需要一些地方，让青少年不必花钱也能见面。

tip: where 引导地点状语或定语从句，先行词是地点。

senses.en: fuel used in car engines, in British English

ex.en: The generator runs on petrol.
ex.zh: 发电机烧汽油。

ex.en: Never store petrol near the heater, and keep the cap closed in the school shed.
ex.zh: 汽油不要放在暖气旁边，在学校棚屋里也要把盖子拧上。

tip: 英式汽油是 petrol。美式是 gasoline 或 gas。加油站是 a petrol station。本卡只讲安全存放，不写其他用途。

senses.en: the way things are not the same
A disagreement between people or groups
The amount by which one quantity exceeds another

ex.en: Age makes little difference in friendship.
ex.zh: 年龄在友谊中几乎没有差异。

ex.en: Understanding cultural differences can help international students adapt more successfully to life in a new country.
ex.zh: 了解文化差异有助于留学生更顺利地适应新国家的生活。

tip: 比较两者用the difference between A and B。

senses.en: in that place

ex.en: There is a new poster on the back wall.
ex.zh: 后墙上有一张新海报。

ex.en: There are still towns where the nearest hospital is more than an hour away by bus.
ex.zh: 仍有一些城镇，乘公交到最近的医院要一个多小时。

tip: There be 句中，be 的单复数跟后面真正的主语走。

senses.en: full of energy and interest

ex.en: The discussion stayed lively until the bell.
ex.zh: 讨论一直很活跃，直到铃声响。

ex.en: A lively market filled the square, with fruit, tools, and people calling out prices.
ex.zh: 热闹的市场占满了广场，有水果、工具，还有人喊价。

tip: lively 是形容词，不是副词。活泼地做某事常用 in a lively way。

senses.en: useful
Willing to help other people.

ex.en: Your notes were very helpful.
ex.zh: 你的笔记很有帮助。

ex.en: Clear feedback is particularly helpful for students who are learning to organise their ideas in academic essays.
ex.zh: 对于正在学习如何组织学术论文思路的学生来说，清晰的反馈尤其有帮助。

col: find something helpful｜觉得某物有帮助
tip: helpful可形容事物有用，也可形容人乐于助人。

senses.en: an illness

ex.en: Clean water helps prevent disease.
ex.zh: 干净的水有助于预防疾病。

ex.en: Access to clean drinking water can significantly reduce the spread of infectious diseases in vulnerable communities.
ex.zh: 获得清洁饮用水可以显著减少传染病在脆弱社区中的传播。

col: the spread of disease｜疾病传播
tip: 重音在第二音节；泛指疾病可不加冠词。

senses.en: a person who visits a place or a person

ex.en: Every visitor signs the book at the lab door.
ex.zh: 每位来访者都在实验室门口的本子上签名。

ex.en: A visitor from the partner school sat in on our class and asked about the timetable.
ex.zh: 伙伴学校的一位来访者旁听了我们的课，并问起课表。

tip: visitor 是来的人。主人是 host。动词 visit。

senses.en: an informal word for a grandmother

ex.en: Granny knits socks every winter.
ex.zh: 奶奶每年冬天都织袜子。

ex.en: My granny tells the same ferry story each visit, and the details grow kinder, not louder.
ex.zh: 我外婆每次来都讲同一个渡船故事，细节变得更温和，而不是更夸张。

col: granny flat｜给老人住的小套间
tip: granny 是口语。作文里更正式的说法是 grandmother。grandpa 已在库里。

senses.en: to stop a planned event
To balance an opposing effect so neither changes the result.

ex.en: They had to cancel the trip because of rain.
ex.zh: 因为下雨他们不得不取消旅行。

ex.en: Improved energy efficiency may cancel out some environmental benefits if it encourages people to consume more.
ex.zh: 如果能源效率提高促使人们增加消费，就可能抵消部分环境效益。

tip: 英式过去式cancelled，美式常用canceled；抵消用out。

senses.en: a period of twelve months

ex.en: This is my second year at this school.
ex.zh: 这是我在这所学校的第二年。

ex.en: A dry year can raise food prices, which hits families who already spend most of their income on meals.
ex.zh: 干旱的一年会推高食品价格，打击那些收入大部分已用于吃饭的家庭。

col: all the year round｜一年到头
tip: 在哪一年用 in：in 2024。

senses.en: between countries
A match between countries, or a player representing a country.

ex.en: English is an international language.
ex.zh: 英语是一门国际语言。

ex.en: International cooperation is essential for tackling environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.
ex.zh: 国际合作对于解决超越单个国家边界的环境问题至关重要。

tip: international涉及多国；domestic指国内的。

senses.en: a warm knitted piece of clothing for the top of the body

ex.en: This sweater is too thick for May.
ex.zh: 这件毛衣五月穿太厚了。

ex.en: She folded the sweater with the sleeves inside so it would fit in the small drawer.
ex.zh: 她把袖子塞进毛衣里叠好，这样就能放进小抽屉。

col: put on a sweater｜穿上毛衣
tip: 英式也说 jumper。sweater 不是 sweat 的人。运动长袖常说 sweatshirt。

senses.en: earlier than
earlier than the time when

ex.en: Please wash your hands before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前请洗手。

ex.en: Cities should test their flood plans before the rainy season, not after the first street is under water.
ex.zh: 城市应该在雨季之前检验防汛方案，而不是等第一条街被淹之后。

tip: before 可作介词、连词或副词。

senses.en: to say what will happen

ex.en: Nobody could predict the final score.
ex.zh: 谁也预测不了最后的比分。

ex.en: The model predicted rain at three, and the first drops came during the break.
ex.zh: 模型预报三点下雨，第一滴雨果然在课间落下来了。

tip: predict 后面接名词或 that 从句。prediction 是名词。

senses.en: to carry, to need time, or to do an exam or trip

ex.en: It takes me twenty minutes to walk to school.
ex.zh: 我步行上学要二十分钟。

ex.en: It can take a generation to repair a forest that was cut down in a single decade.
ex.zh: 修复一片十年内被砍光的森林，可能需要一代人的时间。

tip: It takes sb time to do 表示花时间；spend 的主语是人。

senses.en: causing damage or injury

ex.en: Too much sugar is harmful to your teeth.
ex.zh: 糖吃太多对牙齿有害。

ex.en: The article explains why smoke is harmful and what the school does to keep the air clean.
ex.zh: 文章说明烟为什么有害，以及学校怎样保持空气干净。

tip: harmful to sth。反义是 harmless。名词是 harm。

senses.en: the daughter of one's son or daughter

ex.en: His granddaughter visits on Sundays.
ex.zh: 他的孙女每周日来看他。

ex.en: The letter is for his granddaughter in another city, so he checked the postcode twice.
ex.zh: 这封信是写给住在另一座城市的孙女的，所以他把邮编核对了两遍。

tip: granddaughter 既是孙女也是外孙女，英语不区分父系母系。孙子是 grandson。

senses.en: a person between 13 and 19

ex.en: The course is written for a teenager, not for a child.
ex.zh: 这门课是写给十几岁青少年的，不是给小孩的。

ex.en: Every teenager in the dorm has a different bedtime, which makes the hall noisy.
ex.zh: 宿舍里每个青少年的睡觉时间都不一样，走廊就吵。

tip: thirteen 到 nineteen 都以 -teen 结尾，所以叫 teenager。

senses.en: the way to go; guidance
instructions explaining how to reach somewhere or do something
the control or guidance of an activity or group

ex.en: Ask for direction if you get lost.
ex.zh: 迷路了就问路。

ex.en: Government investment can influence the direction of technological development by supporting research into cleaner energy sources.
ex.zh: 政府投资可以通过支持清洁能源研究来影响技术发展的方向。

col: in the opposite direction｜朝相反方向
under the direction of｜在……的指导下
tip: 表示路线指引或操作说明时，通常用复数directions。

senses.en: very surprising

ex.en: What an amazing view from the hill!
ex.zh: 山顶的景色多么令人惊奇！

ex.en: Recent medical research has produced amazing results, offering new hope to patients with previously untreatable conditions.
ex.zh: 近期医学研究取得了惊人的成果，为患有过去无法治疗的疾病的患者带来了新希望。

col: an amazing experience｜一次奇妙的经历
tip: amazing形容令人惊叹的事物；amazed形容人的感受。

senses.en: to create, or to cause something to happen

ex.en: We make posters for the book fair.
ex.zh: 我们为书展制作海报。

ex.en: Noise from a busy road can make it difficult for children to concentrate in class.
ex.zh: 繁忙道路的噪音会让孩子很难在课堂上集中注意力。

tip: make sb do 不带 to；被动式则是 be made to do。

senses.en: a person in one's family who lived long ago

ex.en: An ancestor planted the old tree.
ex.zh: 一位祖先种下了那棵老树。

ex.en: The family book names each ancestor for five generations, with the village written beside the year.
ex.zh: 家谱写下五代里的每一位祖先，村子写在年份旁边。

tip: ancestor 是祖先。后代是 descendant。形容词 ancestral。写作时对别人的家族保持尊重。

senses.en: a unit of mass, one thousandth of a kilogram

ex.en: Add one gram of salt, no more.
ex.zh: 加一克盐，不要多。

ex.en: The sample weighs 12 grams, which is too little for a second test today.
ex.zh: 样品重 12 克，今天不够再做一次试验。

tip: 符号是 g。一千克是 a kilogram，不是 a gram。本卡例句不用 grammar，免得和克搅在一起。

senses.en: to print or release something for the public

ex.en: The school paper will publish our interviews on Friday.
ex.zh: 校报星期五会发表我们的采访。

ex.en: They refused to publish the photo because the students in it had not agreed.
ex.zh: 他们拒绝刊登那张照片，因为里面的学生没有同意。

tip: publish 是把作品公开。publisher 是出版者，publishing 是出版业。

senses.en: to give something that will be returned

ex.en: Can you lend me a ruler?
ex.zh: 能借我一把尺子吗？

ex.en: The library will lend you the atlas for a week if you show your card.
ex.zh: 出示借书证，图书馆可以把这本地图册借你一周。

col: lend sb sth｜借给某人某物
tip: lend 是借出，borrow 是借入。过去式 lent。lend a hand 是帮忙。
